"""Independent retained-input mutations; never starts the capture server."""

import copy
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(__file__).with_name("capture.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("safari_peer_comparison", path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
checks = {}
for index in range(1, 4):
    directory = module.RETAINED / f"run-{index}"
    raw = (directory / "connection-0.hello.bin").read_bytes()
    original = module.hello_shape(raw)
    compression_offset = 39 + raw[38]
    compression_offset += 2 + int.from_bytes(
        raw[compression_offset : compression_offset + 2], "big"
    )
    assert raw[compression_offset : compression_offset + 2] == b"\x01\x00"
    assert original["compression"] == "00"
    changed_compression = bytearray(raw)
    changed_compression[compression_offset + 1] = 1
    assert module.hello_shape(bytes(changed_compression))["compression"] == "01"
    assert module.hello_shape(bytes(changed_compression)) != original
    random_changed = bytearray(raw)
    random_changed[6] ^= 1
    assert module.hello_shape(bytes(random_changed)) == original
    changed_version = bytearray(raw)
    changed_version[5] ^= 1
    assert module.hello_shape(bytes(changed_version)) != original
    # Independently observed last extension has a GREASE type, length1, body00.
    assert raw[-5:-3] in [bytes([value, value]) for value in range(0x0A, 256, 16)]
    assert raw[-3:] == b"\x00\x01\x00"
    assert module.hello_shape(raw[:-1] + b"\x01") != original
    # Only the GREASE code point is interchangeable; preserve its actual body.
    changed_code = raw[:-5] + b"\x0a\x0a" + raw[-3:]
    assert module.hello_shape(changed_code) == original
    # Locate the key-share body independently of the normalizer. The peer's
    # first share is GREASE/length1/body00, followed by genuine key exchanges.
    offset = 39 + raw[38]
    offset += 2 + int.from_bytes(raw[offset : offset + 2], "big")
    offset += 1 + raw[offset]
    end = offset + 2 + int.from_bytes(raw[offset : offset + 2], "big")
    offset += 2
    grease_share = None
    real_share = None
    while offset < end:
        kind = int.from_bytes(raw[offset : offset + 2], "big")
        length = int.from_bytes(raw[offset + 2 : offset + 4], "big")
        if kind == 51:
            grease_share = offset + 6
            assert raw[grease_share : grease_share + 2] in [
                bytes([value, value]) for value in range(0x0A, 256, 16)
            ]
            assert raw[grease_share + 2 : grease_share + 5] == b"\x00\x01\x00"
            real_share = grease_share + 5
            assert raw[real_share : real_share + 2] == b"\x11\xec"
            break
        offset += 4 + length
    assert grease_share is not None and real_share is not None
    changed = bytearray(raw)
    changed[grease_share + 4] = 1
    assert module.hello_shape(bytes(changed)) != original
    changed = bytearray(raw)
    changed[real_share + 4] ^= 1
    assert module.hello_shape(bytes(changed)) == original
    changed = bytearray(raw)
    changed[grease_share : grease_share + 2] = b"\x0a\x0a"
    assert module.hello_shape(bytes(changed)) == original
    metadata = json.loads((directory / "connection-0.json").read_text())
    projected = module.projection(metadata)
    assert [
        block["stream_id"]
        for block in projected["ordered_headers_and_hpack_representations"]
    ] == [1, 3]
    changed = copy.deepcopy(metadata)
    client = [
        frame
        for frame in changed["analysis"]["frames"]
        if frame["direction"] == "client"
    ]
    client[0]["flags"] ^= 1
    assert (
        module.projection(changed)["client_frame_order"]
        != projected["client_frame_order"]
    )
    changed = copy.deepcopy(metadata)
    changed["analysis"]["client_headers"][1]["block"]["hex"] += "00"
    assert (
        module.projection(changed)["raw_hpack_blocks"] != projected["raw_hpack_blocks"]
    )
    checks[f"run-{index}"] = {
        "retained_parse": True,
        "literal_null_compression_preserved": True,
        "actual_compression_byte_change_detected": True,
        "random_mask": True,
        "version_difference_detected": True,
        "grease_body_00_to_01_detected": True,
        "grease_codepoint_only_normalized": True,
        "grease_key_share_body_00_to_01_detected": True,
        "real_key_exchange_bytes_normalized": True,
        "grease_key_share_codepoint_normalized": True,
        "frame_flags_difference_detected": True,
        "reused_hpack_difference_detected": True,
    }
result = {"driver_sha256": module.digest(path), "checks": checks}
(module.HERE / "offline-checks-after-compression.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n"
)
print(json.dumps(result))
